apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged once per run (Apify synthetic start event; priced per GB of run memory, 1 GB minimum). Target ~$0.001 for a typical 256 MB–1 GB start.

podcast-show.eventDescription: Charged once per successfully resolved podcast show (iTunes and/or RSS metadata with title/feedUrl/collectionId). Failed lookups and empty/broken feeds are free unless chargeFailedShows is enabled. No transcription.

podcast-episode.eventDescription: Charged once per episode metadata row parsed from the show RSS (guid/title/published/duration/enclosureUrl/showNotesHash). Audio is never downloaded. Empty feeds and failed episode parses are free.
